d_and_a.source: Cash flow statements: FY2024 10-K (1,128; 1,075); Q4 2025 earnings release ex-99.1 (1,050)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2024-25 growth ~2%, FY2023 ~6% reported (FX/divestiture drag); organic growth for KO has run mid-single digits, so fade 4.5% to 3.5%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 28.7% (13,762/47,941); FY2024 21.2% depressed by impairments/other charges, FY2023 24.7%. 30% reflects modest normalisation; reviewer to check one-offs.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. KO effective tax rate ~18-21% in recent years; not verified against filing.

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta staple (~0.6), rf ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, cost of equity ~7.5%, after-tax cost of debt ~3.5-4%; blended ~7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below GDP/inflation-plus; mature global brand.

net_debt.source: FY2025 balance sheet (ARS / 10-K): loans and notes payable 1,551 + current maturities of LTD 1,822 + LTD 42,119 = 45,492, less cash & equivalents 10,270 and short-term investments 3,602 (13,872). Excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Q4 2025 earnings release ex-99.1: FY2025 average shares outstanding assuming dilution 4,313 million
